entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Visual Studio: solution template with .slnx primary output not detected on volumes without 8.3 short names (ReFS Dev Drive), projects added flat instead #56391

Closed

  • [aw] Issue Monster Assigner produced no safe outputs #56110
  • Test results in AzDO report unqualified method names after MSTest migration #55123
  • [aw] Failed jobs: ResourceLock refactoring #56366
  • Tests in this repo can't be run simply with `dotnet test` #56067
  • dotnet test path/to/project.csproj fails with an unhandled exception in .NET 11 RC1 #56196
  • dotnet test does not isolate/consume cli parameters correctly #56338

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56400
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56399
  • [ResourceLock] Narrow GivenAPickBestRidMultiThreading serialization to the CWD-mutating test #56398
    Test Debt
  • Harden agentic workflow detection runs #56397
  • Retry connection resets in Build Failure Analysis setup #56396
  • Port runtime PR dotnet/runtime#133111 R2R changes to SDK Crossgen tasks #56395
    Area-ReadyToRun, Area-WasmSdk, 12.0-preview1
  • Improve dotnet format whitespace performance and add persistent cache #56394
  • Fix CA1517 for mutable span enumeration #56393
  • File-based apps: allow metadata on `#:include` #56392
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56372
  • Bump the github-actions group with 2 updates #56389
    dependencies, github_actions

    Test Debt

    Servicing-consider, 11.0-rc2
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Explain MTP exit codes in summaries #56370
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.14
  • Fix repeatable attribute matching in ApiCompat #55448
    Area-ApiCompat
  • Run ResolvePackageFileConflicts tests in parallel without mutating CWD #56365
    Test Debt
  • Fix dotnet test validation with explicit paths #56375

Updated

  • Add shared CLI string resource runtime #56387

  • Avoid process environment mutation in LLM detection tests #56275
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56381
  • Fixed syntax issues and colliding rules in default .editorconfig #56328
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Prevent CA2263 from changing generic System.Type values #56343

    Area-Infrastructure, stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers

    stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers

    stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers

  • Fix locked directory cleanup in Template authoring tests #56367
